title: Token
description: JSON Schema for a token record — a unit of text recognized within a stretch of bytes by a watchlist scanner.

surface.description: The matched bytes as they appeared in the source.

position.description: Where in the source the token appeared.

offset.description: Byte offset of the start of the match in the source.

line.description: One-based line number of the match.

column.description: One-based column number of the match.

kind.description: How the token appears in the source. Bare-prose means appearing in running prose without quoting; code-fenced means inside a fenced code block; quoted means inside quotation marks; link-text means inside the [text](...) portion of a markdown link; link-target means inside the (...) portion; frontmatter-value means inside YAML frontmatter; regex-pattern-match means matched by a hedge-phrase regex rather than a literal token.

source.description: The path or origin of the source the token was found in.
